mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_requests (id, file_id, requester_id, approver_id, status, open_marker, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fileId}, #{requesterId}, #{approverId}, 'OPEN', #{fileId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id AS fileId, requester_id AS requesterId, approver_id AS approverId, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM approval_requests WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, file_id AS fileId, requester_id AS requesterId, approver_id AS approverId, status, created_at AS createdAt, decided_at AS decidedAt FROM approval_requests WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_requests SET status = #{status}, open_marker = NULL, decided_at = #{decidedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_activity (request_id, actor_id, action, comment, `timestamp`) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{comment}, #{timestamp})
mapper.select: SELECT id, requester_id AS requesterId, approver_id AS approverId, status, created_at AS createdAt, decided_at AS decidedAt FROM approval_requests WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
